Notes: built from Robot output.xml (same data as log.html) with build_report7d.py / render_report7d.py; reuses helpers from publish_nactest_compare.py (read-only import). Robot template source (keyword bodies, JSON paths) intentionally omitted; checks are labelled APIC class.attribute. Secret-looking values redacted. No tests run, no APIC contacted, no .env read.
